findings.title: Client-Side RBAC Enforcement Flaw & Privilege Verification Failure
findings.description: Role-based access control (RBAC) was enforced primarily on the client-side JavaScript layer within Vite Admin SPA. By inspecting client state or manipulating local storage permission claims, administrative navigation menus and buttons become unhidden.

evidence.exploit_proof: empire_admin_unhider.js DOM manipulation unlocks admin portal UI

findings.remediation: Implement strict backend authorization checks on all API endpoints; never rely on frontend UI hiding for security boundaries.

findings.title: Unauthenticated User Enumeration & Targeted Credential Spraying
findings.description: Discrepancies in response time, status codes, and JSON error messaging on Better-Auth endpoints allow attackers to enumerate valid student and staff emails. Combined with weak default initial student passwords, multiple accounts were successfully compromised.

evidence.weak_default_passwords_identified: 07 VIP Accounts compromised (197,000,000 VND curriculum value)

findings.remediation: Unify authentication error messages ('Invalid email or password'), enforce progressive delay, and mandate password changes upon initial enrollment.

findings.title: Insufficient Anti-Automation & Credential Stuffing Defenses on Login
findings.description: Login endpoint https://empire.edu.vn/api/auth/sign-in/email processed repeated negative authentication attempts without progressive delay, temporary lockout, or rate-limiting response headers.

last_retest.notes: Could not reach target during retest:

findings.remediation: Implement progressive exponential delay, account lockout threshold (e.g., 5 failed attempts = 15 min lock), and IP-based rate limiting.

findings.title: Proprietary Course Curriculum, Video HLS & Document Leakage
findings.description: Proprietary course structures, chapter outlines, video HLS streaming URLs, and companion PDFs were returned to unauthenticated users calling the public gateway courses routes. 10 core courses and 512 lessons were accessible without an active enrollment purchase.

evidence.extracted_content: 10 Core Courses, 120 Chapters, 512 Lessons, 2,223 Videos, 2,195 PDFs

findings.remediation: Restrict course content detail payloads to users with verified active enrollment claims.

findings.title: Unauthenticated Social Intelligence & User Activity Harvesting
findings.description: The community groups and discussion forum endpoints expose member lists, full names, avatars, and internal group memberships without requiring session credentials. Over 207,000 student and staff memberships across 13 groups were harvestable.
findings.remediation: Enforce authentication on /social/v2/* group member queries and paginate public member lists with strict rate limiting.

findings.title: Client-Side Hardcoded Secrets, Environment Variables & API Routing Leakage
findings.description: Production frontend JavaScript bundles contained un-obfuscated internal API routes, staging subdomains, third-party API keys, and environment configuration objects revealing internal infrastructure architecture.

last_retest.notes: Retest executed. Vulnerability pattern re-verified.

findings.remediation: Purge internal secrets from frontend builds and implement automated secret scanning in the CI/CD pipeline.

findings.title: Missing Clickjacking Defense (X-Frame-Options / frame-ancestors)
findings.description: Web application endpoint https://gw.empire.edu.vn/news does not declare X-Frame-Options or frame-ancestors, allowing adversarial sites to embed this page in an invisible frame for UI redressing.
findings.remediation: Add 'X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN' or configure 'frame-ancestors 'self'' in Content-Security-Policy.

findings.title: Server Information Disclosure
findings.description: The web server reveals software and version details in HTTP headers ('envoy'), assisting attackers during fingerprinting.

evidence.response:
Server: envoy
X-Powered-By: N/A

findings.remediation: Suppress or obfuscate the Server and X-Powered-By HTTP response headers in production.

findings.title: X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing
findings.description: The Anti-MIME-Sniffing header X-Content-Type-Options was not set to 'nosniff'. This allows older browsers to perform MIME-sniffing on the response body, potentially transforming non-executable MIME types into executable script.

evidence.response:
HTTP/1.1 200
server: envoy
date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 11:52:48 GMT
content-type: text/html
last-modified: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 16:38:11 GMT
etag: W/"6aee0273-776"
content-encoding: gzip
x-envoy-upstream-service-time: 1
transfer-encoding: chunked

findings.remediation: Set the X-Content-Type-Options header to 'nosniff' across all HTTP responses.

findings.title: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
findings.description: Content Security Policy (CSP) is an added layer of security that helps to detect and mitigate certain types of attacks, including Cross Site Scripting (XSS) and data injection attacks.

evidence.response:
HTTP/1.1 200
server: envoy
date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 11:52:48 GMT
content-type: text/html
last-modified: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 16:38:11 GMT
etag: W/"6aee0273-776"
content-encoding: gzip
x-envoy-upstream-service-time: 1
transfer-encoding: chunked

findings.remediation: Implement a robust Content-Security-Policy restricting allowed script, frame, and object sources.

findings.title: Missing Anti-clickjacking Header
findings.description: The response does not include either Content-Security-Policy with 'frame-ancestors' directive or an X-Frame-Options header, leaving the page vulnerable to ClickJacking attacks.

evidence.response:
HTTP/1.1 200
server: envoy
date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 11:52:48 GMT
content-type: text/html
last-modified: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 16:38:11 GMT
etag: W/"6aee0273-776"
content-encoding: gzip
x-envoy-upstream-service-time: 1
transfer-encoding: chunked
evidence.matched_content: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors detected in HTTP response headers.

findings.remediation: Modern web browsers support Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors 'none' or 'self', and X-Frame-Options DENY / SAMEORIGIN.
